name: Chinese Trains
author: kaicardenas0618
description:
**Chinese Trains** is a small mod that adds trains from various metro systems across China. The cities available will align with the release of the China maps in the China Map Pack by Kronifer.

## Currently Available Cities (3)
 - [Guangzhou](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guangzhou_Metro#Rolling_stock)
 - [Shanghai](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shanghai_Metro_rolling_stock)
 - [Shenzhen](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shenzhen_Metro#Rolling_stock)

## Currently Available Trains (56)
